title: All in One PvP
description: A PvP texture pack that has every nesesity you could think of, containing, low fire, shield, small totem pops, and utilitys. Its the only texture pack you will ever need!
body:
# A Reasource Pack to Make PvP Easier
- Low Fire
- Low Shield
- Small Totem
- Small Consumables
- Small Pearls
- Small Windcharges
- No Fishing Bobber
- Visable Powdered Snow
- No Explosion Particals
- Ore Borders Including Suspisous Sand and Gravel
- No Firework Particals
- Small Carts and Rails
- Visable Tripwire
- Clearer Trapped Chests
- Visable Dripstone
- No Pumkin Overlay
- Small Totom Pop + No Totom Particals
- No Eating Particals
- Cobweb Outline
